# civo_database (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "civo_size" "small" {
  filter {
    key      = "name"
    values   = ["db.small"]
    match_by = "re"
  }
  filter {
    key    = "type"
    values = ["database"]
  }
}

data "civo_database_version" "mysql" {
  filter {
    key    = "engine"
    values = ["mysql"]
  }
}

resource "civo_database" "custom_database" {
  name    = "custom_database"
  size    = element(data.civo_size.small.sizes, 0).name
  nodes   = 2
  engine  = element(data.civo_database_version.mysql.versions, 0).engine
  version = element(data.civo_database_version.mysql.versions, 0).version
}

# Grow the storage beyond the plan, enable extensions and set server parameters.
# Storage can only be increased; the GB above the plan are billed as an add-on.
resource "civo_database" "tuned_database" {
  name       = "tuned_database"
  size       = "g3.db.small"
  nodes      = 3
  engine     = "PostgreSQL"
  version    = "17"
  storage_gb = 120
  extensions = ["pg_cron", "postgis"]
  database_parameters = {
    max_connections = "200"
  }
}

# Fork an existing database as it was at a point in time. engine and version
# must match the source; size and nodes may differ.
resource "civo_database" "forked_database" {
  name               = "forked_database"
  size               = civo_database.tuned_database.size
  nodes              = 1
  engine             = civo_database.tuned_database.engine
  version            = civo_database.tuned_database.version
  source_database_id = civo_database.tuned_database.id
  source_target_time = "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) The engine of the database
- `name` (String) Name of the database
- `nodes` (Number) Count of nodes
- `size` (String) Size of the database
- `version` (String) The version of the database

### Optional

- `database_parameters` (Map of String) Custom PostgreSQL server parameters as key/value pairs, replacing the current set. An empty map resets them to the defaults; removing the attribute keeps the current ones.
- `extensions` (Set of String) PostgreSQL extensions to enable, replacing the current set. An empty list disables them all; removing the attribute keeps whatever is enabled. Extensions that need it trigger a brief rolling restart when applied.
- `firewall_id` (String) The ID of the firewall to use, from the current list. If left blank or not sent, the default firewall will be used (open to all)
- `network_id` (String) The id of the associated network
- `region` (String) The region where the database will be created.
- `source_database_id` (String) ID of an existing database to fork. The new database is an independent copy built from the source's backups: by default as of its latest backup, or as of `source_target_time`. `engine` and `version` must match the source. Not returned by the API, so an imported fork plans a replacement when this is set.
- `source_target_time` (String) Point in time of `source_database_id` to fork from, as RFC 3339 (e.g. 2026-10-21T10:00:00Z). It must not be earlier than the source's `earliest_restore_time`. Leave unset to fork the source as of its latest backup.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage of every node in GB. It can be grown beyond the plan's base storage but never shrunk; the GB above `base_storage_gb` are billed as a storage add-on.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `base_storage_gb` (Number) Storage in GB included in the plan (size) of the database
- `dns_endpoint` (String) The DNS endpoint of the database
- `earliest_restore_time` (String) Earliest point in time (RFC 3339) the database can be restored or forked to. Empty until the first full backup has completed.
- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint of the database
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the database
- `port` (Number) The port of the database
- `private_ipv4` (String) The private IP assigned to the database
- `read_endpoint` (String) Host of the load-balanced read-only endpoint, available on databases with 3 or more nodes
- `read_endpoint_dns` (String) DNS entry of the read-only endpoint
- `read_endpoint_port` (Number) Port of the read-only endpoint
- `status` (String) The status of the database
- `username` (String) The username of the database

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# using ID
terraform import civo_database.mydb 29fcd1c4-fb61-44c7-b49c-dc7b98e9927e
```
